record.exceptions: Conditional entry permission for commercial trucks stranded between the crossings on September 12 2020.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no current-status inference
record.official_rationale: COVID-19 infections among border officials linked to truck movement.
record.context: Additional freight interruption during national passenger restrictions; reopening required contact-limiting cargo transfer.
record.uncertainty: The ordinary freight restriction began August 13 and general commercial restoration occurred September 27.
